rationale: Raw source confirms non-accrual exposure for the quarter: table 9 row 4 reports Non-Accrual investments of $61.8 million cost and $28.8 million fair value as of December 31, 2025. Representative schedule rows in the reviewed set carry the same non-accrual footnote notation, including Continental Battery Company, TriStrux, LLC, and A&A Global Imports, LLC. Because the reviewed item has 27 nonaccrual positions with surface=false, the flag reflects a real extraction/surfacing gap rather than a false alarm. The exact footnote legend text was not exposed by the CLI searches, so confidence is below maximum, but the filing-level non-accrual anchor decides the question.
